caption: The drawing features three main objects on a light beige or off-white background. In the upper left corner is a small rectangular section showing a close-up detail of decorative trim, colored with shades of green, yellow, and black, and featuring a central flower-like motif with petal shapes and lacy edges. The center right portion of the drawing depicts a large bonnet viewed from the side, shaded primarily with green and accented with pink and white floral decorations along the brim and inside. Below this, slightly right of center, is a second drawing of the bonnet, viewed from a three-quarters angle on a mannequin head or stand. This bonnet is likewise green with hints of pink and white flowers and ribbons draping downward. Both bonnets are outlined in gray pencil with areas of light color for shading and detailing, and the trim detail makes use of stronger color concentrations. The overall composition organizes the objects vertically with considerable empty space around them.
title: Poke Bonnet
